input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to plain SYCL 2020 in port/saxpy.cpp. It has no dpct headers, no DPCT_* macros and no dpct:: helpers. It uses a default sycl::queue with enable_profiling, sycl::malloc_shared/sycl::free for unified memory, a 1-D nd_range<1> with work-group size 256 and a bounds-checked kernel (y[i] = a*x[i] + y[i]), and event profiling for kernel_ms. Compiled with icpx -fsycl -O2 to build/candidate with 0 errors and 0 warnings, and with add_dpct_include=false, so the dpct headers are not needed. Caveat: I have no tool that executes the binary, so the atol=1e-6 comparison against the CUDA reference output has not been run. The arithmetic and initialization match the original line for line, so the result should agree, but this is unverified.
